description: Vuelo fotogramétrico Minas - diciembre 2025 is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by IDE. Productos de información geográfica resultado del vuelo fotogramétrico realizado por la Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales (IDE) en diciembre de 2025 en la ciudad de Minas, departamento de Lavalleja, llevado a cabo tras el proceso de compra directa 6606/2005. Se incluyen imágenes ortorrectificadas, imágenes oblicuas, MDS, MDT, LiDAR y modelo 3D fotorrealista. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher IDE. Its tags are Datos geográficos, Imagen, Modelo 3D, Modelo digital de superficie, Modelo digital de terreno. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, GEOTIFF. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
